purpose: Teach: 改ざん/急騰/募る/整然と/名著/同好/真下/アーム

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、書類、絶対、改ざん、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case seriously — the document tampering investigation is moving forward with full police resources.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady pace. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No rush. The voice of someone stating fact, not performing competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物価の、本気で、絶対、急騰、絶対、警察様にも、絶対、ご対応、絶対、影響、絶対、ありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The price surge has definitely had an impact that reaches into our side of things too. We're grateful for your department's attention to it.
lines.style: Respectful without being stiff. Acknowledging weight with a slight nod in the voice. Careful cadence — showing he understands what's being asked. Warm but formal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、市民協力者を、絶対、募る、絶対、活動、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently recruiting citizen volunteers to assist the investigation. It's an ongoing effort we're committed to.
lines.style: Procedural and clear. As if reading from notes but with natural breath. No embellishment. Each sentence completes before the next one starts. Professional distance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様への、本気で、絶対、報告書、絶対、整然と、絶対、まとめます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we get you a thorough, well-organized report on everything we've found.
lines.style: Earnest commitment in the voice. Slight lean forward in tone. Careful enunciation on "well-organized." The promise of someone who takes follow-through seriously.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査の、本気で、絶対、名著、絶対、警察、絶対、参考、絶対、にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've consulted some key reference materials on investigation procedure — the police department's guidance has been invaluable.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight formality shift — he's paying respect to institutional knowledge. Steady pace. A hint of deference without servility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、同好、絶対、会、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご支援、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'd be very grateful if the police department could lend its support to the community club's efforts in this area.
lines.style: Polite request wrapped in gratitude. Careful pacing — he's asking for something. Warm but measured. Slight emphasis on "grateful" — genuine appreciation underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本社の、本気で、絶対、真下、絶対、駐車場、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll maintain regular patrols of the parking area directly beneath headquarters. That's our priority.
lines.style: Concrete and decisive. Matter-of-fact tone. Each commitment sits solid. No hedging. The voice of someone stating what will happen, not asking if it's acceptable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、最新の、絶対、アーム、絶対、付き、絶対、解除装置、絶対、活用されていますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. You're using the latest equipment for this — the release mechanisms are state-of-the-art. That gives us confidence.
lines.style: Recognizing competence with genuine respect. Slightly slower pace on "state-of-the-art." Warm approval in the undertone. The relief of seeing someone do their job well.
